title: Kifaru
client: D&AD New Blood — Rare & Xbox brief
summary: A game about rhino conservation, made for the Rare & Xbox brief. D&AD New Blood Yellow Pencil, 2021.
overview: Kifaru is a game designed as a force for good. Players reunite a rhino calf with its herd across open African landscapes, learning along the way about the real threats rhinos face and how conservation can help. A playable demo was built in Unity to prove the idea.

challenge.heading: The brief
body: Rare and Xbox asked D&AD New Blood entrants for a game that could entertain and do some good in the world.

idea.heading: The idea
body: Pair striking visuals, light puzzles and open-world exploration with a message players carry out of the game: rhinos need advocates before it's too late.
